name: Trench Warfare
desc:
💥 - Fight in trenches, working together to capture the enemy's flag.

You have been sent to the trenches, prepared to fight to the death with your fellow soldiers. Capture all points and the flag for victory. Use the shovel to dig tunnels to surprise the enemy.

⭐- Favorite and leave a 👍like for more endings and updates!

Game is supported on all platforms PC 🖥️, mobile 📱, tablet 📟, and console 🎮
